purpose: Replicate the passive-validator method on a fresh natural short-fiction baseline before allowing any scale-up. This phase tests method repeatability, not source-rule promotion.
required_method: Create one fresh short-fiction baseline in a new situation without deliberately activating RX-C01 through RX-C08 as construction targets.
Freeze that natural baseline before validation.
Run RX-C01 through RX-C08 only as passive post-draft validators.
If no material located defect exists, return NO_REPAIR_JUSTIFIED and stop.
If a material defect exists, select exactly one located defect and make the smallest possible repair.
Preserve all unrelated prose and story facts.
Blind baseline versus repair before actual-human comparison.
Do not stack candidates or add countdowns, extra clues, mysteries, action beats, or motive withholding merely to satisfy a rule.

human_gate.minimum_interpretation: A second independent directional preference for the repair is required before any bounded scale test is considered.
